title: Pros and cons
description: Weigh advantages and disadvantages in a balanced discussion.

introduction.headline: Weigh both sides
introduction.body: Learn language for advantages, drawbacks, and balanced conclusions.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara il linguaggio per vantaggi, svantaggi e conclusioni equilibrate.

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Un vantaggio è una maggiore flessibilità.

vocabulary.example: A major drawback is reduced collaboration.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Un grande inconveniente è la collaborazione ridotta.

vocabulary.example: On balance, the benefits outweigh the risks.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Tutto sommato, i benefici superano i rischi.

exercises.explanation: A drawback is a disadvantage or negative point.

exercises.prompt: ____ balance, the benefits outweigh the risks.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: ____ balance, the benefits outweigh the risks.
exercises.explanation: On balance introduces a careful overall judgement.

review.tip: Write three pros and two cons of remote work, then give your conclusion.
